instruction.german: Which sentence (A, B or C) is an invitation to play a LARP?

configs.correctAnswer: B The drama club is meeting in the park. We’re going to play a game where we act as different characters!

additionalAnswers.answer: A We’re going to play Monopoly on Friday. Can you come?
B The drama club is meeting in the park. We’re going to play a game where we act as different characters!
C We’re going to meet at Lia’s house and play Minecraft. I hope you can be there.
